title.narrative: Agricultural Development Project in the Region of Kangaba

description.narrative: The project aims at improving agricultural production in the Kangaba Region to alleviate poverty and improve food security through the construction of 10 small dams which will provide supply of water to the local farmers for irrigation purposes during the dry season. A reinforcement of the social infrastructure in the Region will also take place through the provision of 7 schools, 6 adult literacy centers, 10 health centers, 17 boreholes and wells.
